about_the_game:
IN THE NEVERLIGHT, THE SUN IS GONE

Welcome to a world where daylight no longer exists, taken over by the Plague of Shadows that turns animals and people into monsters. In the darkness, survivors gather around what light remains, offering bounties to hunters brave enough to fight the creatures that roam the endless night. Enter this dangerous world as a bounty hunter, competing with rivals to track, hunt, and escape with your hard-earned treasures—if you survive.

HUNT, COMPETE, EXTRACT, SURVIVE

  • DEADLY MONSTER HUNTS - Track and battle powerful corrupted beasts inspired by Dark Souls and Elden Ring. Each monster requires skill and strategy to defeat.

  • 3-PLAYER COOP - Team up with two friends to hunt monsters, gather resources, and watch each other's backs in the darkness. Strength in numbers improves your odds of survival.

  • COMPETE WITH RIVAL HUNTERS - Face other hunter teams in a dangerous dance of alliances and betrayals. Kill them for their bounties or work together against greater threats.

  • HIGH-STAKES EXTRACTION - Everything you find is yours only if you make it out alive. Weapons, armor, materials, and treasures must be extracted to become permanent.

  • DYNAMIC WORLD EVENTS - Each hunt features random scenarios with multiple paths. Defend a village from monsters, raid a passing caravan, or explore abandoned ruins.

THE TWILIGHT DOMINION

Explore a vast map featuring both open wilderness and claustrophobic interiors. The world shifts between twilight, night, and deep darkness, changing how you must approach each encounter.

Gather clues to reveal what's happening across the map. Some locations hold valuable bounties, others contain scenario-specific events or unexpected dangers. The more you know, the better your chances of survival.

Ordinary people still struggle to survive in this brutal world. Their settlements offer moments of respite and sources of information—but they may not welcome all hunters equally.

BUILD YOUR CAMP, CRAFT YOUR ARSENAL

  • PLAYER CAMP - Develop your own personal base between hunts where you can rest, craft, and prepare for your next expedition.

  • CONSTRUCTION SYSTEM - Build and upgrade various structures in your camp that unlock new crafting options, storage capacity, and gameplay features.

  • DEEP CRAFTING - Gather materials like plants, ore, and leather during hunts to craft weapons, armor, potions, and tools back at camp.

  • PLAYER MARKET - Unlock the trading post to buy, sell, and barter with other players. Trade rare materials, specialized gear, or valuable artifacts.

ABILITY SHARDS & EQUIPMENT

  • COLLECTIBLE ABILITY SHARDS - Discover and collect these powerful fragments throughout your journey. Each shard grants a unique active or passive ability, but you can only equip a limited number per hunt. Experiment with different combinations to create your perfect build.

  • COMPREHENSIVE GEAR SYSTEM - Loot and craft equipment for all slots: helmets, chest armor, gauntlets, leggings, boots, rings, amulets, and capes. Each piece contributes unique attributes that directly enhance your character's combat capabilities.

  • MEANINGFUL ATTRIBUTES - Every piece of equipment affects your character's core attributes, determining your effectiveness with different weapons and abilities. Build for strength, agility, resilience, or magical prowess.

  • RARITY & UNIQUE EFFECTS - Discover rare and legendary equipment with special properties that fundamentally change how you approach combat and exploration.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-7700 or AMD™ Ryzen 5 2500x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 (3GB), Intel® Arc™ A380, or ATI Radeon™ RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: Hunt nightmarish monsters in 3-player coop for bounty in a realm of endless night. Each expedition features unique events, dangers, and rewards. Battle creatures, bosses, and rival hunters for precious loot. Extract with your treasures or join countless hunters who vanished in the darkness.
